info.title: Cisco Meraki Dashboard API — camera
info.description: The camera operations of the Cisco Meraki Dashboard API, split by product area from Cisco's published OpenAPI definition.

x-provenance.note: Split by first tag from Cisco's published spec3.json; operations unmodified.

get.description: Returns live state from camera analytics zones
get.summary: Returns live state from camera analytics zones
get.x-deprecation-notice: Deprecated: This operation has been marked as deprecated. For more information, visit the deprecated operations page

get.description: Returns an overview of aggregate analytics data for a timespan

parameters.name: t0
parameters.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 365 days from today.

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description: The end of the timespan for the data. t1 can be a maximum of 7 days after t0.

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameters t0 and t1. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 7 days. The default is 1 hour.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: [optional] The object type for which analytics will be retrieved. The default object type is person. The available types are [person, vehicle].

get.summary: Returns an overview of aggregate analytics data for a timespan
get.x-deprecation-notice: Deprecated: This operation has been marked as deprecated. For more information, visit the deprecated operations page

get.summary: Returns most recent record for analytics zones

get.description: Return historical records for analytic zones

parameters.name: t0
parameters.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 365 days from today.

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description: The end of the timespan for the data. t1 can be a maximum of 14 hours after t0.

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameters t0 and t1. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 14 hours. The default is 1 hour.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: The time resolution in seconds for returned data. The valid resolutions are: 60. The default is 60.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: [optional] The object type for which analytics will be retrieved. The default object type is person. The available types are [person, vehicle].

get.summary: Return historical records for analytic zones
get.x-deprecation-notice: Deprecated: This operation has been marked as deprecated. For more information, visit the deprecated operations page

get.description: Generate a video clip of up to 5 minutes long.

parameters.name: startTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time for the clip. The timestamp is expected to be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: endTimestamp
parameters.description: The end time for the clip. The timestamp is expected to be in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: imagerId
parameters.description: The imager ID to query. Required for multi-imager cameras (must be between 1 and the imager count). For single-imager cameras, must be omitted or set to 0.

expiry.description: Expiration details for snapshot image access

example.expiry: Access to the image will expire at 2018-12-11T03:12:39Z.

get.summary: Generate a video clip of up to 5 minutes long.

post.description: Generate a snapshot of what the camera sees at the specified time and return a link to that image.

timestamp.description: [optional] The snapshot will be taken from this time on the camera. The timestamp is expected to be in ISO 8601 format. If no timestamp is specified, we will assume current time.

fullframe.description: [optional] If set to "true" the snapshot will be taken at full sensor resolution. This will error if used with timestamp.

expiry.description: Expiration details for snapshot image access

example.expiry: Access to the image will expire at 2018-12-11T03:12:39Z.

post.summary: Generate a snapshot of what the camera sees at the specified time and return a link to that image.

profileId.description: Quality and retention profile ID; null if not using a profile

restrictedBandwidthModeEnabled.description: Whether restricted bandwidth mode is enabled

quality.description: Video quality; null when the camera's stored configuration cannot be decoded into a documented quality value

resolution.description: Video resolution; null when the camera's stored configuration cannot be decoded into a documented resolution value

get.summary: Returns quality and retention settings for the given camera

put.description: Update quality and retention settings for the given camera

profileId.description: The ID of a quality and retention profile to assign to the camera. The profile's settings will override all of the per-camera quality and retention settings. If the value of this parameter is null, any existing profile will be unassigned from the camera.

motionBasedRetentionEnabled.description: Boolean indicating if motion-based retention is enabled(true) or disabled(false) on the camera.

audioRecordingEnabled.description: Boolean indicating if audio recording is enabled(true) or disabled(false) on the camera

restrictedBandwidthModeEnabled.description: Boolean indicating if restricted bandwidth is enabled(true) or disabled(false) on the camera. This setting does not apply to MV2 cameras.

quality.description: Quality of the camera. Can be one of 'Standard', 'High', 'Enhanced' or 'Ultra'. Not all qualities are supported by every camera model.

resolution.description: Resolution of the camera. Can be one of '1280x720', '1920x1080', '1080x1080', '2112x2112', '2880x2880', '2688x1512' or '3840x2160'.Not all resolutions are supported by every camera model.

motionDetectorVersion.description: The version of the motion detector that will be used by the camera. Only applies to Gen 2 cameras. Defaults to v2.

get.summary: List the quality retention profiles for this network

post.description: Creates new quality retention profile for this network.

name.description: The name of the new profile. Must be unique. This parameter is required.

motionBasedRetentionEnabled.description: Deletes footage older than 3 days in which no motion was detected. Can be either true or false. Defaults to false. This setting does not apply to MV2 cameras.

restrictedBandwidthModeEnabled.description: Disable features that require additional bandwidth such as Motion Recap. Can be either true or false. Defaults to false. This setting does not apply to MV2 cameras.

audioRecordingEnabled.description: Whether or not to record audio. Can be either true or false. Defaults to false.

cloudArchiveEnabled.description: Create redundant video backup using Cloud Archive. Can be either true or false. Defaults to false.

motionDetectorVersion.description: The version of the motion detector that will be used by the camera. Only applies to Gen 2 cameras. Defaults to v2.

enabled.description: Boolean indicating if Smart Retention is enabled(true) or disabled(false).

smartRetention.description: Smart Retention records footage in two qualities and intelligently retains higher quality when motion, people or vehicles are detected.

scheduleId.description: Schedule for which this camera will record video, or 'null' to always record.

maxRetentionDays.description: The maximum number of days for which the data will be stored, or 'null' to keep data until storage space runs out. If the former, it can be in the range of one to ninety days.
